```{r}
data("mtcars")

selected_data <- mtcars[
  , c("mpg", "disp", "hp", "drat", "wt", "qsec")
]

cat("First 5 rows of selected data:\n")
print(head(selected_data, 5))

cat("\nBasic statistical summary:\n")
print(summary(selected_data))

cat("\nDataset dimensions:\n")
print(dim(selected_data))
```

```{r}
scaled_data <- scale(selected_data)

cat("First 5 rows of standardized data:\n")
print(round(head(scaled_data, 5), 3))

cat("\nMeans after standardization:\n")
print(round(colMeans(scaled_data), 4))

cat("\nStandard deviations after standardization:\n")
print(round(apply(scaled_data, 2, sd), 4))
```

```{r}
pca_result <- prcomp(
  scaled_data,
  center = FALSE,
  scale. = FALSE
)

cat("PCA summary:\n")
print(summary(pca_result))

cat("\nFirst 5 principal component scores:\n")
print(round(head(pca_result$x, 5), 3))
```

```{r}
eigenvalues <- pca_result$sdev^2

variance_proportion <- eigenvalues / sum(eigenvalues)

cumulative_variance <- cumsum(variance_proportion)

variance_table <- data.frame(
  Principal_Component = paste0(
    "PC", seq_along(eigenvalues)
  ),
  Eigenvalue = round(eigenvalues, 4),
  Proportion = round(variance_proportion, 4),
  Percentage = round(variance_proportion * 100, 2),
  Cumulative_Percentage = round(
    cumulative_variance * 100, 2
  )
)

print(variance_table)
```

```{r}
number_components <- which(
  cumulative_variance >= 0.80
)[1]

cat(
  "Minimum number of principal components required:",
  number_components, "\n"
)

cat(
  "Cumulative variance explained:",
  round(
    cumulative_variance[number_components] * 100,
    2
  ),
  "%\n"
)
```

```{r}
plot(
  eigenvalues,
  type = "b",
  pch = 19,
  xlab = "Principal Component",
  ylab = "Eigenvalue",
  main = "Scree Plot for PCA"
)

abline(h = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray")
grid()

cat(
  "Variance explained by PC1:",
  round(variance_proportion[1] * 100, 2),
  "%\n"
)

cat(
  "Variance explained by PC2:",
  round(variance_proportion[2] * 100, 2),
  "%\n"
)

cat(
  "Cumulative variance explained by PC1 and PC2:",
  round(sum(variance_proportion[1:2]) * 100, 2),
  "%\n"
)
```

```{r}
loadings <- pca_result$rotation

cat("Loadings for PC1 and PC2:\n")
print(round(loadings[, 1:2, drop = FALSE], 4))

cat("\nVariables ranked by absolute loading on PC1:\n")
print(round(
  sort(abs(loadings[, 1]), decreasing = TRUE),
  4
))

cat("\nVariables ranked by absolute loading on PC2:\n")
print(round(
  sort(abs(loadings[, 2]), decreasing = TRUE),
  4
))

pc1_top <- names(
  sort(abs(loadings[, 1]), decreasing = TRUE)
)[1:3]

pc2_top <- names(
  sort(abs(loadings[, 2]), decreasing = TRUE)
)[1:3]

cat("\nThree strongest variables for PC1:\n")
print(pc1_top)

cat("\nThree strongest variables for PC2:\n")
print(pc2_top)
```

```{r}
biplot(
  pca_result,
  choices = c(1, 2),
  scale = 0,
  cex = 0.7,
  main = "PCA Biplot: mtcars"
)
```
